entities.summary: Edward Glenn Bryant is an American politician who is a former Republican member of the United States House of Representatives from Tennessee (1995–2003). From 1991 to 1993, he served as the United States Attorney for the Western District of Tennessee. Bryant later served as a United States magistrate judge for the Western District of Tennessee from 2008 to 2019.
